lines: It floated in the night.
A moon like a jellyfish burst.
If you look behind the bus stop.
That summer you is on my mind.
Only.
Torii, dry clouds, the scent of summer brushes my cheek.
Until we become adults, we stay stretched out, unchanged.
When play tires us, let's look at the sky behind the bus stop.
Even when summer soon fades.
Because I'll surely remember.
We grow into adults still unable to catch up.
Night blooms in your pocket.
If I can't say it, I'm alone.
That's fine, I've already given up.
Only.
Summer day, dry clouds, mountain cherry sea, rusted sign.
Memory always smells of summer.
A photo is just a piece of paper.
A memory is merely dust.
Because I don't understand, I keep my mouth shut, unchanged.
Continuously, your presence, a single summer field stone in memory.
We become adults still looking down.
Can't catch up, only you are clear.
We climbed the slope still unable to speak.
Night blooms upon our shadows.
We grew into adults still looking down.
Clap your hands as you wish, unchanged.
Climbing the slope where the sun sets.
Our shadows are
We become adults still unable to catch up.
Night blooms in your pocket.
Even if we can't speak, we are one.
That should be fine, already.
I chew on your memories.
Only.
